decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Faithless Looting and Thoughtseize to fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty. By utilizing cards like Unearth and Persist, the deck aims to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield quickly. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Psychic Frog and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's resources. The strategy centers around quickly reanimating powerful threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to use control elements combined with land destruction to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Cleansing Wildfire, Field of Ruin, and Erode, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base and limit their options. Cards like Avengers Disassembled and Wrath of the Skies help control the board while Price of Freedom can provide a way to regain control of the game. The inclusion of the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard adds an additional element of synergy to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of reanimation spells and powerful creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By discarding big creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty with cards like Faithful Mending and Thoughtseize, then reanimating them with spells like Persist and Ephemerate, the deck aims to create a fast and aggressive win condition. The deck also includes disruption spells like Prismatic Ending and counterspells like Psychic Frog to control the game and protect its combo pieces.

This deck focuses on assembling Urza's lands (UrzaTron) to quickly generate a large amount of mana and play powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. It also utilizes Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck aims to establish board control, disrupt the opponent's hand, and ultimately overwhelm them with powerful threats and a massive amount of mana.

This deck focuses on disruption and removal spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells to keep the opponent on their toes and prevent them from executing their game plan effectively. The inclusion of creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide additional threats and win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game through a mix of permission spells and removal, while also presenting threats of its own.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes powerful creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Solitude to win the game while maintaining control. The deck also includes graveyard hate like Relic of Progenitus to disrupt opponent's strategies and protect its own creatures. Additionally, the deck includes card advantage engines like Ephemerate and Quantum Riddler to outvalue the opponent in the long game. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's three-color strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. The strategy is to disrupt the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending while setting up the combo pieces. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand are key creatures in this deck, providing additional utility and card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Solitude for removal and Faithful Mending for card filtering. The goal is to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It relies on efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to deal damage quickly, while also using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge to pump up creatures and maximize damage output. The mana base includes dual lands like Sacred Foundry and Stomping Ground to ensure consistent mana production for the aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Gemstone Caverns and Eldrazi Temple to play massive Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog and Emrakul. It also utilizes control elements like Ugin's Labyrinth and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes ways to generate additional mana and buffs for its creatures with cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Disciple of Freyalise. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board and generating mana efficiently.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy and controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently trading resources and maintaining card advantage. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion and card draw to generate long-term advantage. By slowing down the opponent's game plan, the deck can steadily build towards its win condition, whether it's through overwhelming with powerful creatures or simply exhausting the opponent's resources. The key is to dictate the pace of the game and grind out a victory through attrition.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, along with removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to maintain board control. Ranger-Captain of Eos helps tutor for key creatures, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional support and buffs for the team. The deck aims to close out games quickly with a combination of damage output and strategic plays.

The deck focuses on using powerful creatures like Basking Broodscale, Emrakul, and Glaring Fleshraker in combination with spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings to search for key pieces and generate value, the deck aims to quickly assemble a game-winning combo. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Sowing Mycospawn helps to further enhance the deck's synergies and overall game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional value with her proliferate ability, while Solitude and Thoughtseize help control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes ways to draw cards and protect key pieces like Griselbrand. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures in the early turns of the game.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blinking effects to disrupt the opponent and gain advantage. By using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Ephemerate, the deck can protect its creatures and reuse powerful enters-the-battlefield abilities. Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter provide additional value with their abilities triggered by blinking. Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help control the opponent's board while Solitude offers removal and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and disruptive blinking effects.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. It utilizes a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers such as Teferi to maintain control of the board. The deck also includes a variety of lands to help fix mana and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to outlast the opponent and eventually win through card advantage and powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Solitude.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Simic color combination to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful creatures and spells. The key strategy is to use cards like Birthing Ritual to accelerate mana production and cast spells like Shardless Agent and Ice-Fang Coatl to quickly establish board presence. With a mix of countermagic and disruptive spells like Flare of Denial and Endurance, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and versatile creatures. Card advantage and tempo are crucial in maintaining pressure and controlling the game.
